page.title: Jokkondire
page.intro: Jokkondir e konte maa yeeynooje. Ardiiɓe ummoriiɓe e jeeyngal maa ina ngara e Ardiiɓe am otomatik, tawa ko e njoɓdi e njoɓdi kala ardotooɗo.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form ina ardoo e nder Ardiiɓe am, njoɓdi ñalnde kala e njoɓdi kala ardotooɗo, e kalite ardotooɗo neldaama to LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn jokkondirii. Ardiiɓe ina ƴettee jooni - ngoo hello ina hesɗitina e nder dumunna.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn sosaaka tawo e ooɗoo serveer. Gardiiɗo ina foti ɓeydude ID e sirlu kiliyaneeɓe app LinkedIn .
banner.expired: Jokkondiral LinkedIn ngal gasii, ko ɗum waɗi ardiiɓe ɓee sinkronisaaki. Jokkondira kadi ngam jokkude.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn ina ɗaɓɓi nde naatataa kadi ko adii {{date}} . Jokkondir ko adii ndeen ngam jokkude jolngo.

connect.title: Jokkondir LinkedIn
connect.intro: Naat e konte LinkedIn toppitiiɗe yeeynorɗe maa. Leadrat ina jannga tan konte maa yeeyirde, Lead Gen Form ardii e limlebbi yeeyirde, kadi ina nelda waylooji ɗi njiyloto-ɗaa.
connect.need1: Darnde e konte ad LinkedIn (Yiylotooɗo walla ɓurɗo ɗum).
connect.need2: Darnde e hello sosiyetee jokkondirɗo (Njuɓɓudi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator walla Analyst) - LinkedIn ina ɗaɓɓi nde renndinta ardorde.
connect.need3: Naamnal limoore telefoŋ e dow Lead Gen Forms maa - leads ɗi ngalaa limoore telefoŋ mbaawaa ɓeydeede.

connection.title: Jokkondiral
connection.autoRenews: Access ina hesɗitina otomatik haa ndeen
connection.syncResult: Sinkronisaasiyoŋ waɗii: {{received}} keɓii, {{created}} sosaa, {{duplicates}} duppitiiɓe, {{rejected}} saliima.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Seerndude LinkedIn ? Sinkronisaasiyoŋ ina dartoo, toɓɓe jokkondire ɗee ina momtee. Ardiiɓe, limtooji e doggol golle ina keɓee.
connection.noPermission: Aɗa waawi yiyde ngoo hello. Jokkondirde e waylude dottaaɗe ina ɗaɓɓi yamiroore "Njuɓɓudi dottaaɗe".
connection.fetchHint: Ardiiɓe kesi ina ƴeewtee kala hojomaaji seeɗa e balɗe 7 cakkitiiɗe ɗee ina ƴeewtee kadi ñalnde kala, ko ɗuum waɗi alaa ko ŋakki. Huutoro ɗum ngam ardaade ko adii nde njokkondirtaa, walla ngam ƴeewtaade dumunna kadi (hade balɗe 90 e sahaa gooto). Leads gonɗi e Leadrat ina njuutee.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} tawaama, {{created}} sosaa, {{duplicates}} duppitiiɓe, {{rejected}} saliima, {{skipped}} naatnaama tawo.

accounts.none: Alaa konte ad tawaaɗe e ndee konte LinkedIn . Ƴeewto darnde konte ɗee e nder LinkedIn Campaign Manager , caggal ɗuum hesɗitin.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Haalan LinkedIn hol e ardiiɓe mum wonti yiɗɓe goonga. So ardorde LinkedIn yettiima darnde nde cuɓ-ɗaa les ndee, Leadrat ina haalana ɗum LinkedIn , ngam ciimtol kampaañ maa hollirta kalite ardorde e LinkedIn ina waawa yiytude yimɓe ɓurɓe yiɗde ardorde maa ɓurnde moƴƴude. Ko ID ardotooɗo LinkedIn e hash laawol gootol e iimeel oo tan neldetee.
capi.created: Waylo-waylo sosaa ko e LinkedIn e kartoŋaaji.

activity.title: Log golle
activity.intro: Kala ko woni hakkunde Leadrat e LinkedIn : jokkondiral, kala sinkronisaasiyoŋ, kala ardorde e ko waɗi ɗum, waylooji e majjere.
